audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Skill/Quinn/Quinn, giving Quinn the 2+ item row and calling Level 1 and Levels 4-5 even.
audit.why: 58.78% over 621 games and the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-5, Vayne row 6. The prose already says Vayne is one of the weakest early laners and that the late game flips to her at Botrk + Shieldbow, so the chart contradicted its own text at both ends.
audit.corrected: Quinn rows 0-5, Vayne row 6, in both layers.

audit.why: Spike ladder (Lvl 1-2 range, Lvl 3 full pattern, 1st item last clean kill window, 2+ items Vayne) is accurate and already names Silver Bolts, Tumble and Condemn.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Condemn (E) cancels Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines channel, and Tumble (Q) is an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the burst tell.
audit.why: Quinn's R carries the channel flag 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'; Condemn is hardCC with knockup, so it interrupts the channel outright. Tumble carries autoReset, meaning her damage lands on the attack after the tumble, not on the cast.
audit.corrected: Condemn wall-stuns and cancels your R channel — bait it before you commit; and read the Tumble wind-up, not the cast, as the moment to step back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block named Condemn with no numbers and never mentioned Tumble.
audit.why: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s maxed, and Tumble is 6s at rank 1 down to 2s maxed (shorter still under Final Hour). Those numbers are what makes 'wait for it' actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d under 'Fight her at 2 items' read 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' — leftover template text about the reader's own ability.
audit.why: It describes nothing in this matchup.
audit.corrected: Botrk plus Shieldbow and W true damage beat any kite you have.

audit.whatIsWrong: Final rating line says 'Even matchup' while diff is FAV and the win rate is 58.78%.
audit.why: Internal contradiction on the same page.
audit.corrected: Favourable early — difficulty 6/10, Vayne carry threat 9.5/10.
